title: The explicit intrinsic chain comparison on unit generators
statement: For any finite-level coefficient cochain complexes P,Q, conjugating the inverse ordinary signed-total tensor pullback isomorphism by the prescribed degreewise finite realization gives a chain isomorphism from the intrinsic pullback of their total tensor to the total tensor of their intrinsic pullbacks. This isomorphism sends each inverse-image unit of a homogeneous pure generator to the pure generator of the two inverse-image units. No K-flatness or invertibility condition is required.

source.place: Tag 07A4, proof of lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 06YS for K-flat resolutions; ordinary sheaf tensor pullback in modules on sites, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: Conjugate the inverse ordinary signed-total tensor comparison by the prescribed degreewise finite realization to construct the chain isomorphism.

The inverse realization sends an intrinsic adjunction unit to the ordinary adjunction unit. Apply the ordinary total generator equation, the total-map generator equation, and the forward realization unit equation in both factors.

theorem finitePullbackTensorChain_generators {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ) :
    ∀ (p q i : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = i) (U : Y.ProEt)
    (x : (P.X p).val.obj (op U)) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj (op U)),
    ((finitePullbackTensorChainIso l E f n P Q).hom.f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
      (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app
          (((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj (P, Q)).X i)).val.app (op U)
        (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P Q p q i hpq (op U) x y)) =
    coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X)
      (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P)
      (((sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q i hpq
      (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
      (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app (P.X p)).val.app (op U) x)
      (((sfIntrinsicConstantModuleAdjunction f
        (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))).unit.app (Q.X q)).val.app (op U) y)
